scope: Independent verification of PSD-SQLITE-FAMILY-001 SQLite queue database-family corruption recovery

checks.check: no drift between approved PR head and current worktree implementation file

independent_verification.method: Standalone script driving DistillationJobQueue directly, separate from the implementation's own pytest suite. Does not modify any implementation file.
per_case_checks: every family member this run wrote for the case appears in the receipt (subset check, since sqlite may transiently create -shm mid-open even when only main+-wal were written)
no member kind outside {main, -wal, -shm} is ever quarantined
quarantine destination files exist on disk under the receipt's recovery_id

main and -wal quarantined bytes are byte-identical to the original corrupt bytes (pure rename, not a rewrite); -shm is excluded from this exact check because opening a WAL-mode database rewrites the shared-memory index in place before the malformed-header error surfaces whenever both -wal and -shm pre-exist
the fresh queue at the original path accepts a transactional write/read probe (enqueue + get)
the fresh queue's state is durable across a clean reopen of the same path
no second recovery receipt is written on the clean reopen
independent_verification.result: PASS: 4/4 cases, 9/9 checks per case, overall_passed=true
independent_verification.import_bootstrap_fix: The script previously imported services.source_ingestion.distillation_worker without any sys.path setup, so a bare `python3 <script>` from repository root raised ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'services' (the repo's top-level packages are only importable via the provisioned .venv-pantheon interpreter, not a system python3). The script now resolves and inserts the repository root onto sys.path before that import, so the exact documented command is reproducible with any interpreter that has the repo's third-party dependencies (a bare system python3 included), independent of provisioning, PYTHONPATH, or cwd.

verification.result: exit 0, overall_passed=true (db_only, wal_only, shm_only, full_family all pass); reproduced with a bare system python3 from repository root after the sys.path bootstrap fix
